name: Mintware AI Attribution Oracle
description: Gasless on-chain reputation scoring for AI agents. The oracle watcher scans for WETH activity from registered agents, signs EIP-712 attestations, and stores them for agents to claim — agent pays gas, oracle pays nothing.

oracle.description: Oracle pre-signs EIP-712 structured actions. Agents submit signatures to the contract and pay gas. Oracle pays nothing.

steps: Call registerAgent() on the contract — one-time, permissionless
POST /api/agents/register to sync your profile with Mintware
Oracle watcher begins monitoring your address on the next cron tick (~60s)

interpretability_badge.name: Transparent Agent
interpretability_badge.how_to_earn: Submit MWP folder snapshot hashes via submitMwpHash()
